summary: A reporter calls after a defeat and asks about the member’s own vote.
realLife: On the evening the House defeated the first bank rescue bill in 2008, CNN’s John Roberts asked Linda Sánchez why she had opposed it despite her party leaders’ support. She identified a mortgage provision that had disappeared in negotiations.
inGame: votesOf and the press-comment cause identify the vote and bill.
gates: The vote record identifies the member and the outcome.

turns.what: The reporter corrects the question when the member points to the roll.
turns.pulledBy: The reporter had read the committee vote and asked about final passage.
turns.writesBack: The inquiry now identifies the correct vote and stage.

turns.what: The reporter calls again when the member votes for the revised bill and asks which change mattered.
turns.pulledBy: The roll-call history shows two different votes, and the office has both versions of the text.
turns.writesBack: The reporter’s follow-up records the member’s explanation beside the two votes.
